decisive_items: On MRI, the lesion was intradural and extramedullary
On lumbar spine CT, there was a well-defined hyperdense lesion at the L3 level.
The preoperative diagnosis was thought to be a meningioma
response.rationale: The lesion is intradural/extramedullary, hyperdense on CT, and uniformly enhancing, all compatible with meningioma; the preoperative diagnosis was meningioma. However, the absence of a dural tail and dural continuity are atypical, so diagnostic confidence is limited.
